PV Sindhu reaches Japan Open final, wins title

Indian badminton player PV Sindhu has reached the final of the Japan Open, with some reports indicating she won the title. She defeated world number five Han Yue in the quarterfinals and progressed through other rounds. This marks her first final in over two years and potentially her first Japan Open title.
